milestones.name: Fight IQ
milestones.summary: We laid the groundwork for wrestlers to make more believable decisions in the ring. Different approaches can be weighed against the situation instead of relying on the same answer every time. This was a step toward smarter matches, not a promise that every planned behavior is already active.
milestones.player_impact: Over time, you should see contests where wrestlers know when to push, defend, or search for a finish. Wins and losses should feel earned through decisions as well as ability.

milestones.name: Match DNA
milestones.summary: We built better ways to understand the rhythm and identity of a wrestling match. Match DNA helps us see how different styles and situations shape the action. Some experimental style features were deliberately kept off while we tested them.
milestones.player_impact: A technical contest and a high-energy brawl should not read like the same match. This foundation helps us build more variety without letting one style become unfairly dominant.

milestones.name: Crimson Canvas
milestones.summary: We improved the way a match tells its story, especially when wrestlers take punishment. Clearer written action, meaningful wounds, and better handling of referee stoppages came together in a tested internal milestone.
milestones.player_impact: When someone fights through danger, gets hurt, or the referee has to step in, the moment should make sense. The goal is a match you can picture, follow, and remember.
